instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In an indoor studio with a plain dusty pink background, two friends share a joyful laugh. On the left, the curly-haired woman in a white button-down shirt (R1) laughs heartily with her mouth open, facing toward the left. Behind her on the right, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) stands smiling with closed eyes, resting her right hand on the curly-haired woman's shoulder. Soft, warm studio lighting casts a gentle glow over the scene, highlighting the pastel pink palette and their cheerful expressions.
